viewports.chipBar: single scrolling row with overflow arrow

states.name: loading
states.trigger: a refinement (chip change) after results are on screen
states.userSees: shell and chip bar stay; the selected chip moves immediately; the results list becomes skeleton rows (43 skeleton elements, no result rows, no thumbnails) until the new results arrive

states.name: ready
states.userSees: filter chips with one selected, a Filters control, and a mixed result list: promoted tiles, channel cards, channel content shelves, Shorts shelves and video rows; each video row has a thumbnail, two-line title, view/age metadata, channel avatar and name, two-line description, badges and an overflow action; a load-more control ends the list

states.name: empty
states.userSees: not observed: every query tested, including a random string, returned a spelling suggestion plus suggested results rather than an empty panel

states.name: error
states.userSees: not surfaced: blocking the refinement endpoint left the server-rendered results in place with no alert and no retry

states.name: offline (warm)
states.trigger: chip change while the network is down
states.userSees: the previous results stay on screen; no alert, no retry

states.name: offline (cold)
states.trigger: navigation while offline after the app shell has been cached
states.userSees: an authored offline panel: 'no internet connection' heading, guidance to connect, and the shell still visible; not the browser error page

states.name: disabled
states.userSees: no account-only controls; the channel card offers a subscribe action that leads to an auth surface (not followed); results include promoted tiles

controls.name: query field
controls.behaviour: prefilled with the current query; submitting navigates to /results?search_query=…

controls.name: clear query
controls.behaviour: empties the field; only present when a query is present

controls.name: filter chips
controls.behaviour: six chips observed (all, short-form, unwatched, videos, recently uploaded, live); exactly one selected; selecting one refilters in place without a route change; first change in ~0.55-0.72s, settled in ~1.5-1.8s; the row scrolls horizontally with an overflow arrow on narrow viewports

controls.name: filters panel
controls.behaviour: opens a panel with five groups (type, duration, upload date, features, prioritise) in ~0.14s; Escape closes it in ~0.04s and returns focus to the trigger

controls.name: result row
controls.behaviour: thumbnail and title open the watch route; each row also carries an overflow action

controls.name: row overflow
controls.behaviour: present on video rows and promoted tiles; not exercised here (menu behaves as on the home surface)

controls.name: channel subscribe
controls.behaviour: out of scope: requires an account; never followed

controls.name: short-form shelf
controls.behaviour: vertical short-form items in a horizontal row (160x239 at 390, 216x324 at 1280); each opens the short-form surface

controls.name: load more
controls.behaviour: explicit load-more control at the end of a list/shelf, not infinite scroll; appends results in ~0.35-0.81s

events.to: ready with focus on the trigger

timingsMeta.method: in-page PerformanceNavigationTiming/Paint/LCP/CLS/long-task entries; interaction latency from input dispatch to observed DOM change
timingsMeta.note: navigation timings are a single sample (n=1) taken on a slow search load and are not a distribution

a11y.reducedMotion: no running CSS animations reported before or under prefers-reduced-motion (0 and 0)

filtersButton.alignment: right edge of the content column

gaps.question: What does the surface show when a query truly matches nothing?
gaps.why: Random strings still produced a spelling suggestion plus suggested results; no query or filter combination was found that yields a zero-result list.

gaps.question: Is there any authored error or retry when a search request fails?
gaps.why: Blocking the refinement endpoint left the server-rendered results on screen with no alert; the initial load is server-rendered, so an XHR-level failure cannot be observed from outside.

gaps.question: How much of the result set is suppressed by the network's Restricted Mode?
gaps.why: The page carried a Restricted Mode notice: some results were removed network-administratively, so composition is not representative of an unrestricted session.

gaps.question: What is the latency and scroll/focus behaviour after choosing a filter option?
gaps.why: Only panel open/close and focus return were measured; option selection was not exercised.

gaps.question: What happens on subscribe and other account actions?
gaps.why: They require an account; the guardrails exclude following them.

gaps.question: Is a skeleton shown on the very first search navigation?
gaps.why: The initial response is server-rendered; the skeleton was only observed on a client-side refinement (chip change).

gaps.question: Exact mobile thumbnail dimensions and row composition
gaps.why: Mobile result thumbnails are below the fold and lazily loaded, so the captured snapshot has row boxes but not every image box.

gaps.question: Accessible name of the query field
gaps.why: The focus walk recorded the field but not a resolved accessible name.

gaps.question: Voice search behaviour
gaps.why: Requires microphone permission and speech input; not attempted.

gaps.question: What appears once the last result page is loaded?
gaps.why: Load-more was measured but the terminal state of the list was not reached.

gaps.question: Which result types depend on region, locale or experiment?
gaps.why: One region/locale was observed; promoted tiles and shelves vary by assignment.
